hooks.command:
LOG=$(mktemp)
uv run mkdocs build --strict > "$LOG" 2>&1
code=$?
if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -c 4000 "$LOG" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
out = sys.stdin.read()
reason = 'mkdocs build --strict failed. Fix the reported errors before finishing.\n\n' + out
print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': reason}))
"
else
  echo '{}'
fi
rm -f "$LOG"
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying deck build with mkdocs build --strict...

hooks.command:
LOG=$(mktemp)
# Only lint decks this run actually touched (working tree + untracked), so a
# cleanup pass on one chapter doesn't get blocked by pre-existing issues in
# other, unrelated decks. Falls back to every deck if nothing is dirty (e.g.
# re-running the check after everything is already committed).
CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- 'slides-src/*.md' | awk '{print $NF}')
if [ -z "$CHANGED" ]; then
  CHANGED=$(ls slides-src/*.md)
fi
uv run python scripts/check_slide_density.py $CHANGED > "$LOG" 2>&1
code=$?
if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -c 4000 "$LOG" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
out = sys.stdin.read()
reason = 'Slide density check failed -- split the flagged slides (do not regenerate the whole deck), then rebuild.\n\n' + out
print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': reason}))
"
else
  echo '{}'
fi
rm -f "$LOG"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking slide density against the style guide...
